The other people are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: photographed from inside a real Korean commercial bank branch on a weekday afternoon, camera at standing eye level in the customer queue. A Korean man in his sixties, thinning grey hair, a worn grey zip-up jacket over a checked shirt, stands at the right of the frame at the teller window, holding four thin passbooks fanned out in one hand with a perished rubber band still looped around them and a faded receipt sticking out of one cover. On the teller glass in front of him, at mid frame height, a small red printed notice sticker reads "1억", and a white board above the window carries the word "예금자보호" in plain black lettering. His expression: inner eyebrows pulled up and together, eyes fixed low on the red sticker rather than on the teller, lips parted just enough to show the lower teeth with the corners dragged down, the index finger of his free hand pressed flat on one passbook line, the knuckles of the hand holding the passbooks gone pale.
